s.note: Aunt May asking Peter to pick up eggs on the way home
s.how: Whisk 8 eggs with 100ml milk, 100g grated cheddar, sliced spring onion and diced ham. Pour into a greased 12-hole muffin tin and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until puffed and set. Serve warm to someone who came home late again.

s.note: the Oscorp labs where Dr Connors works
s.how: Blitz 200g thawed edamame with 2 avocados, the juice of 2 limes, a handful of mint and salt until smooth. Cut pita into wedges and bake until crisp. Serve the dip with the pita and cucumber sticks, lab green.

m.note: the dinner at Gwen's apartment where Peter argues with her dad
m.how: Halve 2 chicken breasts and crumb in egg and panko mixed with grated parmesan. Pan-fry until golden and cooked through. Roast 1kg potato chunks at 220C for 45 minutes. Serve with buttered green beans, family style around a busy table.

w.note: Dr Connors turning into the Lizard
w.how: Crush 250g biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Whisk a can of condensed milk with 3 yolks and the zest and juice of 4 limes. Pour in and bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Chill and top with whipped cream. Green and a little scaly.

d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming with a drop of vanilla. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate until smooth and frothy. Pour into mugs and drink slowly in a quiet library corner, waiting for someone to swing by.
